compute_kl_divergence: compute the Kullback-Leibler divergence between two PyTorch distribution objects
register_kl_divergence: register a custom KL divergence function for a pair of distribution types
calculate_normal_kl: calculate KL divergence between two Normal distributions
calculate_multivariate_normal_kl: calculate KL divergence between two MultivariateNormal distributions
